project_description: Polyglot Turborepo multi-agent AI application: Next.js 16.3 frontend (AI SDK 7 / @ai-sdk/react 4 / useChat) → FastAPI Python 3.13 backend (Pydantic AI v2, LlamaIndex, VercelAIAdapter, HITL) with type-safe API contract pipeline, 4-layer test strategy, Logfire/OTEL observability, and staged monorepo build via Turborepo 2.10.11. Assembled in a new repository (vaz-agentic-ai-next) by importing the existing vaz-ai-next monorepo as its base, then adding apps/agent-api.

repository.name: vaz-agentic-ai-next
repository.note: This repository is NOT vaz-ai-next. vaz-ai-next is an upstream repository whose contents are imported by T-0.
